description: A chrome-sided diner beached on the corner where Voss Avenue meets Meltwater Row, its neon sign buzzing MEL WATER — the T long dead — over a fogged window full of pie no one's touched since morning. Steam curls from a roof vent that smells of griddle grease and burnt coffee. A hand-lettered card in the door reads CARD TAP ONLY. NO, NOT EVEN YOURS.
name: Meltwater Diner
